The provided text explores the theme of legacy within the context of a spaceship carrying the last of humanity to a new world. The main idea centers on the weight of responsibility that characters bear as they make decisions that will shape the future of their species. The narrative delves into the complex emotions associated with starting anew, highlighting both the hope for a fresh beginning and the grief of leaving the old world behind. Ultimately, the story emphasizes the profound impact of individual actions on the collective destiny of humanity.
